module: "Windows" window of the editor (Window > Window Position Reset... menu). It lists all registered editor windows (editor.getWindowsState()), sorted by title and filterable, with two buttons per window: "Move to center" (recenters the window in the viewport) and "Highlight" (outlines the window with an orange rectangle for 3.5 s). Useful when a window is lost off-screen.
notes: If the "Windows" window itself goes outside the viewport, it is moved back to (40, 40) relative to the main viewport.

In onEditorInitialized, the code also creates editor.editModes.assetBrowserEditMode = {onToolbar = nil, icon = nil}, which overwrites the asset browser's edit mode if it already existed (probably a copy-paste).
The window title is "Windows" but the file uses an internal windowName "windows"; recentering uses getImGuiWindowName(key, data) = title .. '##' .. key.

onEditorGui.desc: Editor hook called every UI frame. Draws the "Windows" window (search filter and two-column table) then the current highlight rectangles.

onEditorInitialized.desc: Editor hook called at initialization. Registers the window (size 800x500) and adds the "Window Position Reset..." menu entry.
